title: Prior Cash Breadth Leadership and Relative Native Book Value

macro_program.name: entry_signal_market_structure
macro_program.reason: The treatment is completed-cash-session breadth leadership inside the U.S. large-cap market and is tested first as a state of existing native signal and birth supply. Any portfolio risk or slot implication is downstream, not the primary program.

research_height.transfer_path: prior completed U.S. cash-session breadth leadership -> next native-day signal and durable-birth composition -> component-period-centered US30 versus US100 lifecycle value -> possible whole-portfolio book risk or slot question

central_question: Does equal-weight versus capitalization-weight leadership in the last completed U.S. cash session materially and broadly rotate the next native server day's economic value toward the existing US30 book or the existing US100 book?

lenses: mechanism: classify the last completed common RSP/SPY cash session by the sign of its equal-weight-minus-cap-weight open-to-close log return
transmission: compare next-day native signal counts, durable-birth counts and book shares under BROAD_LEADS and MEGACAP_LEADS

portfolio result and falsification: compare component-period-centered stressed-R and stop effects by book, then test the US30-minus-US100 difference-in-differences for period, component and contribution breadth
research_bundle.common_boundary: Only official public RSP/SPY daily OHLC and immutable CP2 event identity/date fields define exposure. Final value, planned risk and stop reason remain closed until the declaration and acquisition boundaries each reach origin/main.

frontier_selection.selection_reason: It has a direct bridge to the unresolved asymmetric US30/US100 portfolio role, introduces a genuinely new official cash-market composition role, is known before the next native decision day, and can change whether one later conditional book-risk or slot question deserves implementation study.

rejected_before_opening.reason: Unit 090 exhausted its correction allowance and closed invalid; receipt reconstruction, exact-day and adjacent expiration variants are frozen.
Natural complete evidence has not accumulated, and this Goal forbids Live polling, replay or synthetic rows.
Units 076, 084 and 088 already bound adjacent native-index dispersion, participation and external-price-state roles; thresholding those fields would be adjacent pursuit rather than a new data role.

why_now.current_bottleneck: Units 050 and 072 show that US30 and US100 are both economically useful but asymmetrically protective, while no existing evidence authorizes when portfolio attention or risk should rotate between them. Unit 085 also shows that opportunity supply is largely upstream of admission, making a causally prior market-structure state relevant before any risk conclusion.
connection_bridge: US30 reduced US100 maximum drawdown in all four periods in Unit 050, and Unit 072 preserved both books while identifying US30 as the stronger protector of US100.
RSP versus SPY distinguishes broad constituent participation from capitalization-weighted mega-cap leadership without inventing a new native entry signal.
If the state changes both books in opposite, broad directions, a later full-portfolio conditional book-risk or slot decision would differ; if not, unconditional treatment remains authoritative.
why_now.perspective_distance_from_recent: Unit 090 was a preannounced listed-options calendar and failed before economics. Unit 089 was delayed weekly regulatory positioning. Unit 091 instead uses the prior completed cash session, official ETF composition/OHLC data, a daily market-breadth mechanism and a relative two-book difference-in-differences.
why_now.decision_if_positive_relative_did: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future whole-portfolio candidate asking whether BROAD_LEADS should condition bounded risk or slot toward US30 relative to US100.
why_now.decision_if_negative_relative_did: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future whole-portfolio candidate asking whether BROAD_LEADS should condition bounded risk or slot toward US100 relative to US30.
why_now.decision_if_null_ambiguous_or_invalid: Preserve unconditional book behavior, retain no breadth seed and rotate away.

distinction_from_closed_work.unit_050_natural_book_drawdown_complemen: Unit 050 established the portfolio bridge but did not define a predecision state or conditional book rotation rule.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_072_us100_book_economic_role: Unit 072 rejected insurance-only reclassification and kept both positive books; Unit 091 conditions their relative value rather than reopening removal or unconditional allocation.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_076_prior_intraday_index_dispersion: Unit 076 used an exact 12:00 broker H1 three-index dispersion magnitude from native CFDs. Unit 091 uses no H1 path, lookback, magnitude or three-index threshold; it uses the prior completed U.S. cash session's official equal-weight-minus-cap-weight open-to-close sign.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_084_predecision_market_participatio: Unit 084 tested native quote participation and volume. Unit 091 uses no quote-count, tick-volume or current-session participation field.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_089_cftc_relative_flow: Unit 089's delayed weekly leveraged-money relative flow was a strong null. Unit 091 uses no futures positioning, trader category, release lag or level and changes the causal timing and data role.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_090_standard_options_expiration_wee: Unit 090 closed invalid before economics and cannot be repaired. Unit 091 uses neither options semantics nor a calendar treatment.

treatment_and_causal_boundary.relative_intraday_return: For each common Nasdaq cash trading date T, compute log(RSP_close / RSP_open) - log(SPY_close / SPY_open) from unadjusted official daily OHLC.
treatment_and_causal_boundary.broad_leads: BROAD_LEADS when the relative intraday return is strictly greater than zero.
treatment_and_causal_boundary.megacap_leads: MEGACAP_LEADS when the relative intraday return is strictly less than zero.
treatment_and_causal_boundary.tie_rule: A zero relative return is invalid; no epsilon, tiebreak, threshold or neutral state may be added.
treatment_and_causal_boundary.native_day_mapping: For each CP2 server date D, use the latest common Nasdaq cash date T strictly earlier than D. Do not timezone-remap D and require D minus T to be no more than four calendar days.
treatment_and_causal_boundary.availability: The entire cash session T is complete before every native decision on D, so no same-day close or future price is used.
treatment_and_causal_boundary.open_to_close_reason: Open-to-close isolates within-session leadership and avoids making ETF distributions or overnight gaps the treatment. No adjusted price, distribution correction or close-to-close replacement is allowed.
treatment_and_causal_boundary.no_proxy_claim: RSP-minus-SPY is a composition and breadth-leadership state, not direct evidence of dealer flow, index-futures positioning, sector causality or a tradable ETF strategy.

official_sources_to_freeze_after_declara.expected_semantics: The equal-weight index uses the same S&P 500 constituents and equal weights at quarterly rebalance.
The S&P 500 is a float-adjusted market-capitalization-weighted large-cap U.S. equity index.

premetric_structural_feasibility.scope: Only official external OHLC plus CP2 event type, component, server date and period were used. No final value_b, planned risk, stressed R, stop reason, conditional lifecycle outcome, gate or verdict was read or calculated.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row; state_sequence is not a primary key. Sort within each fresh period only for lifecycle alternation.
fixed_reconstruction.normal_day: Exactly one SIZE_DAY server date within each fresh period. Keep all normal days, including zero-signal or zero-birth days.
fixed_reconstruction.native_signal: Each SIGNAL_DECIDED event is one observed native passed opportunity; repeated same-day events remain distinct.
fixed_reconstruction.birth: OPEN for five market components and PASSIVE_FILL for Passive.
fixed_reconstruction.lifecycle: Pair each birth to the next same-component CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE under strict one-open-lifecycle alternation. Parse positive planned risk from final detail; stressed R is final value_b divided by planned risk; EXTERNAL_CLOSE is a stop.
fixed_reconstruction.state: Map every normal day and birth by the latest strictly prior common official cash date. A lifecycle retains its birth-date state.
fixed_reconstruction.lifecycle_centering: Within each of 24 component-period cells, subtract the full-cell mean stressed R and full-cell mean stop indicator from every lifecycle before state aggregation.
fixed_reconstruction.book_effects: For each book, compute BROAD_LEADS minus MEGACAP_LEADS in mean centered stressed R and centered stop indicator.
fixed_reconstruction.relative_did: Compute US30_BOOK effect minus US100_BOOK effect. Positive stressed-R DID favors US30 relative to US100 under BROAD_LEADS; negative favors US100 relative to US30.
fixed_reconstruction.contribution_weights: For stressed R, each row weight is +1/n for US30-BROAD, -1/n for US30-MEGACAP, -1/n for US100-BROAD and +1/n for US100-MEGACAP. Weighted rows sum exactly to the relative DID. Aggregate weighted rows by period or component; concentration is absolute group contribution divided by the sum of absolute group contributions.

fixed_reports.mechanism: Report official source pins, normalized common-date coverage, state counts, lag distribution and relative-return range.
fixed_reports.transmission: Report raw signal/day, birth/day and US30/US100 birth shares pooled and by four periods for both states; these are descriptive and cannot independently select a candidate.
fixed_reports.portfolio_result: Report raw and centered stressed-R and stop effects by both books, four periods and six components, plus relative DIDs.
fixed_reports.falsification: Report opposite-book sign, period sign breadth, book-adjusted component alignment and period/component concentration.
fixed_reports.limits: State that an ETF composition association does not identify sectors, dealer flow, futures positioning, intraday timing or a deployable allocation rule.

requirements: All twelve immutable local inputs retain exact bytes and SHA-256 hashes.
Both official semantic HTML snapshots, both raw Nasdaq JSON snapshots, one normalized common-date OHLC CSV and one acquisition receipt exist at committed hashes before lifecycle outcomes open.
Each Nasdaq response has status success, exactly 1,044 unique finite positive OHLC rows, identical common dates from 2022-06-24 through 2026-08-21, and zero zero-return state ties.
Reconstruct exactly 16,477 event rows, 1,051 normal days, 2,429 signals and 2,233 complete lifecycles with zero duplicate, overlap, pending, unmatched birth/final, planned-risk or period-end fault.
Reproduce exactly 2,027 CLOSE and 206 EXTERNAL_CLOSE finals and pooled stressed net 407.0477 USD.
Map all 1,051 normal days and all 2,233 births to a strictly prior common cash date no more than four calendar days old.
Both states exist in all four periods, both books and all six components, with at least 40 births in every period-book-state cell and at least 8 births in every period-component-state cell.
All 24 component-period centering cells are finite.
Absolute relative stressed-R DID is at least 0.10R.
sign(relative stressed-R DID) multiplied by relative stop DID is at most -0.025.
US30 and US100 centered stressed-R book effects have strictly opposite signs.
The relative stressed-R DID sign repeats in at least three of four period-level relative DIDs.

At least four of six component effects align with the selected book-adjusted orientation, with at least one aligned component from each book. For a positive relative DID, aligned means US30 component effect above zero or US100 component effect below zero; reverse those signs for a negative relative DID.
No period contributes more than 60 percent and no component more than 55 percent of the absolute relative stressed-R DID contribution mass.
Absolute relative stressed-R DID is at most 0.05R.
Absolute relative stop DID is at most 0.025.
Neither relative stressed-R DID sign appears in at least three of four periods.
Neither book-adjusted orientation has at least four of six aligned component effects with at least one aligned component from each book.

fixed_verdict_rules.positive_pass: PASS_BROAD_LEADERSHIP_FAVORS_US30_RELATIVE_BOOK_RETAIN_ONE_RISK_SLOT_QUESTION when integrity and every directional requirement pass with positive relative stressed-R DID.
fixed_verdict_rules.negative_pass: PASS_BROAD_LEADERSHIP_FAVORS_US100_RELATIVE_BOOK_RETAIN_ONE_RISK_SLOT_QUESTION when integrity and every directional requirement pass with negative relative stressed-R DID.
fixed_verdict_rules.no_field: NO_MATERIAL_PRIOR_CASH_BREADTH_RELATIVE_BOOK_FIELD when integrity and every strong-null requirement pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_PRIOR_CASH_BREADTH_BOOK_ROTATION_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity passes and no preceding verdict applies.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_PRIOR_CASH_BREADTH_OR_LIFECYCLE_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_VERDICT when any source, event, lifecycle, mapping, coverage or density requirement fails.

decision_translation.directional_pass: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future whole-portfolio real-tick bounded risk-or-slot question in the observed book orientation. No implementation opens in Unit 091.
decision_translation.no_field: Preserve unconditional book treatment and retain no breadth seed.
decision_translation.ambiguous_or_invalid: Preserve unconditional behavior or the observation gap, retain no breadth seed and rotate away.
